description: Implementation of the TaxRateService interface, providing methods to retrieve, delete, and manage tax rate entities within a sales management system, with dependencies on DAO objects and other domain models.

classes.name: TaxRateServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing tax rate management functionalities, extending generic entity service and integrating with DAO layer to perform CRUD operations and specific queries related to tax rates.

methods.name: TaxRateServiceImpl
methods.description: Constructor injecting TaxRateDao dependency and initializing the service.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tax rates associated with the specified merchant store.

methods.name: listByStore (overloaded with Language parameter)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tax rates associated with the specified merchant store, tailored for a specific language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a tax rate by its code within a merchant store.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves tax rates matching the specified country, zone, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves tax rates matching the specified country, state/province, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified tax rate entity after retrieving it by ID.
